Fueling Deicing

Sıcak nozül

A component of ground de-icing equipment that delivers heated anti-icing or de-icing fluid under pressure for effective removal of ice and snow.

Kisa cevap: A component of ground de-icing equipment that delivers heated anti-icing or de-icing fluid under pressure for effective removal of ice and snow.

Bu terim sayfasi, hizli dizine ekleme ve acik dil kapsami icin Protermify Aviation sozlugunun bir parcasi olarak statik HTML biciminde yayinlanir.

Kisa cevap

A component of ground de-icing equipment that delivers heated anti-icing or de-icing fluid under pressure for effective removal of ice and snow.

Neden onemli

Sıcak nozül, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Fueling Deicing baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Sıcak nozül havacilikta neden onemlidir?

Sıcak nozül, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Fueling Deicing baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Sıcak nozül kimler tarafindan kullanilir?

Sıcak nozül agirlikli olarak Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew tarafindan kullanilir.

Sıcak nozül hangi kategoriye aittir?

Bu tanim hangi kaynaga dayanir?

Bu tanim ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG kaynaklarina dayanir ve Protermify Aviation tarafindan statik havacilik referansi olarak yayinlanir.
